info.title: Airline Management API - Flights
info.description:
OpenAPI definition migrated from the legacy VB.NET WinForms **EditFlightForm** (`BtnUpdate_Click`). Replaces the update-flight workflow with a REST endpoint.

**Legacy behaviour preserved:**
- All fields are trimmed and validated before saving.
- `flightNumber` must be unique, but only when it has changed from the stored value.
- `price` must be greater than 0.
- `availableSeats` must not be negative.
- On success the entire flight record is replaced.
- On failure all validation messages are returned together.

/flights/{flightId}.description: Operations on a single flight identified by its ID.

put.description:
Replaces the editable fields of an existing flight. Mirrors legacy `EditFlightForm.BtnUpdate_Click`.

**Validation rules (from legacy code):**
- `flightNumber`, `origin`, `destination` are required (whitespace-only is rejected).
- `flightNumber` must not already exist for another flight (checked only when the value differs from the stored flight number).
- `price` must be greater than 0.
- `availableSeats` must not be negative.

All validation errors are collected and returned together with HTTP 400.

parameters.name: flightId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the flight to update. In the legacy form this is the `selectedFlightId` passed to the constructor.

requestBody.description: Full set of editable flight fields. Maps to the legacy form textboxes and date/time pickers.

200.description: Flight updated successfully. Legacy equivalent: MessageBox 'Flight updated successfully!' followed by closing the form.

400.description: Validation failed. Legacy equivalent: validation messages shown in `lblError`, joined by line breaks. Examples: 'Flight number is required.', 'Flight number already exists. Please use a unique flight number.', 'Origin is required.', 'Destination is required.', 'Valid price is required.', 'Price must be greater than 0.', 'Valid available seats is required.', 'Available seats cannot be negative.'

errors: Flight number already exists. Please use a unique flight number.

401.description: Unauthorized. The legacy form has no authentication check; this is required for the modernized API.

403.description: Forbidden. The authenticated user is not allowed to modify flights. The legacy form has no role check; this is required for the modernized API.

example.message: You do not have permission to update flights.

404.description: Flight not found. Legacy equivalent: `LoadFlight` shows 'Flight not found.' when `GetById` returns nothing. The legacy update itself does not check existence, so this is required for the modernized API.

500.description: Internal server error. Legacy equivalent: `lblError` set to 'An error occurred: ' followed by the exception message when the database update fails.

example.message: An error occurred: Database connection failed.

UpdateFlightRequest.description: Editable fields of a flight. Corresponds to the legacy `Flight` model fields set by the form (Id is taken from the path).

flightNumber.description: Unique flight number. Trimmed before validation. Must be unique when changed.

origin.description: Departure airport or city. Trimmed before validation.

destination.description: Arrival airport or city. Trimmed before validation.

departureTime.description: Departure time of day in HH:mm:ss (legacy `TimeSpan`).

arrivalTime.description: Arrival time of day in HH:mm:ss (legacy `TimeSpan`).

price.description: Ticket price. Must be greater than 0 (legacy `ValidatePrice`).

availableSeats.description: Number of available seats. Cannot be negative (legacy `ValidateAvailableSeats`).

UpdateFlightResponse.description: Success response. Legacy code only displays a success message and closes the form.

ErrorResponse.description: Error response. `errors` holds the individual validation messages (legacy `List(Of String)`).

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token. The legacy application has no authentication check, so this scheme is an assumption for the modernized API.
